name: GIB2A POWER - FrSky Neuron ESC Telemetry

releaseNotes.content:
# GIB2A POWER v26.1.3

Advanced FrSky Neuron ESC Telemetry Dashboard for ETHOS

- Automatic display invalidation limited to 1 Hz
- Native ETHOS annular-sector rendering
- Experimental PNG mask renderer removed
- RX Battery uses the normalized and cached standard source engine
- RSSI Dashboard and Flight Summary use a dB fallback when ETHOS supplies no unit
- Explicit ETHOS RSSI units remain unchanged
- Flight Summary includes Max RPM, Max Current, Max Power, Min Pack Voltage, duration, and separate RSSI minima
- Gauge rendering validated on X20 Pro AW with ETHOS 26.1 Nightly; validation on every stable ETHOS release is not claimed
- Existing telemetry, alarms, callouts, Smart Battery, chrono, persistence, and layouts otherwise preserved

Verify the installation and telemetry sources on the target radio before flight.
